usage.outputShape: unknown (untested — Fly.io Machines API JSON proxied through httpay gateway)
quirks: URL is a wildcard-path gateway proxy: %7B*path%7D decodes to {*path}, a placeholder you MUST replace with a real Fly.io Machines API path before calling
Requires a concrete Fly.io app name and sub-route (e.g. /v1/apps/<app>/machines) — not derivable from the registry spec
httpay gateway proxy: an unpaid pre-flight returns 402 (looks payable) but that does NOT mean an arbitrary/unfilled path will work; paying an unresolved path risks a charge-then-404
inputSchema is only {type:http,method:GET,discoverable:true} — no body schema, no instructions, no paymentAccepts in the registry surface
usage.guide: This endpoint is an httpay x402 gateway proxy to the Fly.io Machines API. The CALL URL contains a wildcard placeholder {*path} that an agent MUST replace with a concrete Fly.io Machines API route before calling — for example POST .../api/gateway/flyio/v1/apps/<your-app>/machines with a machine-config JSON body. Provisioning/managing VMs is an outward, billable, stateful action, so it requires a target app name and explicit user approval. It was NOT pay-tested here because the path placeholder is unresolvable from the spec and paying a blank/wrong path would lose money to a 404.
